goal: What is the request limit per second for the Upland region? Cite every chunk your answer depends on.

chunk-000.text: The standard request limit is 180 requests per minute for every region.

chunk-001.text: The standard limit does not apply to the Upland region, which uses 3 times the standard limit.

chunk-002.text: All limits in this corpus are expressed per minute; convert to per second by dividing by 60 and round to 2 decimals.
